literal_meaning: ডামার আওয়াজ এবং গোলমাল (drumbeat and tumult)
example_sentences_in_bangla: যুদ্ধের ডামাডোলে সবকিছু উলটপালট হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: In the commotion of the war, everything turned upside down.
Suddenly, there was chaos in the market.
history: The idiom originates from the sounds of war drums (ডামা) and the resulting tumult (ডোল) during battles in historical contexts.
